summary: Simon Property Group, L.P. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an underwritten offering of two series of senior unsecured notes: notes due 2032 and notes due 2036. Principal amounts, coupons, and maturities are left blank in the preliminary filing. The notes will be unsecured and unsubordinated obligations, ranking equally with existing unsecured debt, and are redeemable prior to maturity at make-whole prices. J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, PNC Capital Markets LLC, and Wells Fargo Securities are joint book-running managers. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets issuance, not a special situation; watch for final pricing and any impact on the REIT's leverage profile.
